mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, tenant_id, subject_id, payload_version, occurred_at, publication_status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, last_error_code FROM ainer_identity_access_event WHERE ORDER BY occurred_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, event_type, tenant_id, subject_id, payload_version, occurred_at, publication_status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, last_error_code FROM ainer_identity_access_event WHERE id = #{eventId} AND FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_identity_access_event SET publication_status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, available_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, published_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{eventId} AND publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
